div.div:
ex-aedĭfĭcātĭo , ōnis, f. exaedifico,
I.a building, erecting, completion of an edifice; trop. of an oration: “ipsa autem exaedificatio posita est in rebus et verbis,” Cic. de Or. 2, 15, 63 ; Ambros. in Psa. 118, Serm. 4, § 15.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
